<pre class="pseudocode" data-line-number="true">
\begin{algorithmic}
\Procedure{RotateRight}{$y$}
\State $x\gets y.left$; $B\gets x.right$
\State $x.right\gets y$; $y.left\gets B$
\State parent/root link가 $y$ 대신 $x$를 가리키게 갱신
\State $h(y)$ 갱신; $h(x)$ 갱신
\State\Return $x$
\EndProcedure
\end{algorithmic}
</pre>
